linkedin:
The full video: Epsonics closing their set with Fleetwood Mac's "The Chain" at The Triffid.

Epsilon's band went full Severance for the night, walking on out of a blackout to the show's title music, and they saved this for last: The Chain with three voices stacked on the harmonies, that bass break, and a finish as big as the room could take. They took the highest judges' score of the night and finished second overall.

Watch it loud. Video shot by Aaron Griffiths and Kurt Boldy.

Proudly powered by Jumbo Interactive Limited. Every dollar raised goes to Youngcare, supporting young Australians with high care needs to live with more choice, freedom and dignity.
